notes: 7 traps and 2 junctions become 9 sites; 20 paths join traps through junctions, all on one shared transport channel with 18 waveforms, one per motion.
Durations are whole microseconds from the machine's cost model (corrected): a path is its split, segments, junction crossings and merge; R 5 µs, MS 25 µs, readout 120 µs, pumping 50 µs.
7 gate zones get one calibration per exact waveform of the program (4 waveforms), on their own optical channels; a broadcast R reaches every gate zone, one ion per zone.
